name: Matua
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (matua.co.nz) Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc from Matua in New Zealand. Classic Kiwi SB - crisp, vibrant, tropical. Great value!

🍷 STYLE: Crisp Sauvignon Blanc | Passion fruit, grapefruit & herbs | Bright acidity | Classic New Zealand character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, salads, goat cheese, fresh dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Classic New Zealand SB. Vibrant, tropical style!

name: Jacques Dumont
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Loire Valley Sauvignon Blanc from France, rated 90 by Wine Enthusiast. Old World, mineral style.

🍷 STYLE: Crisp Loire Sauvignon Blanc | Citrus, gooseberry, cut grass & flint | Bright acidity, no oak | Clean, chalky finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Shrimp cocktail, fried calamari, goat cheese, salads, grilled salmon, haddock.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: A strong bottle to suggest for the table; check the vintage on the list when presenting.

name: Saint Clair
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Family-owned Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc from Saint Clair in New Zealand.

🍷 STYLE: Vibrant Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc | Passionfruit, grapefruit, lime & fresh herbs | Zesty acidity | Clean, juicy finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Shrimp cocktail, Grilled Caesar, beet salad, goat cheese, seafood, salmon.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: A strong bottle to suggest for the table; check the vintage on the list when presenting.

name: Cloudy Bay
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (cloudybay.co.nz) Cloudy Bay - the wine that put Marlborough on the map! Iconic New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc. World-renowned quality!

🍷 STYLE: Crisp Sauvignon Blanc | Intense passion fruit, citrus & herbs | Vibrant, complex | Marlborough benchmark.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, sushi, oysters, fresh dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Iconic New Zealand wine. The original Marlborough SB that started it all!

name: Flouret
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (flouret-sancerre.com) Sancerre from Flouret estate in Loire Valley. Terroir-focused, organic farming. Pure Loire expression!

🍷 STYLE: Crisp Sancerre | Mineral, citrus & green apple | Bright acidity, clean finish | Organic quality | Terroir-driven.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Oysters, seafood, goat cheese, fresh shellfish.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Organic Sancerre. Pure, terroir-focused Loire!

name: Domaine Francois Crochet Exils
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (crochet-sancerre.com) 'Exils' Sancerre from prestigious Francois Crochet. Premium cuvée from old vines. Serious collector's Sancerre!

🍷 STYLE: Crisp Sancerre | Intense minerality, citrus & complexity | Old vine concentration | Premium Loire terroir | Age-worthy.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Oysters, seafood, fine French cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Premium old-vine Sancerre. Collector-quality Loire!
